decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The surface and basement car parks hereby approved shall not be occupied until details of car parking (including motor cycle parking) and covered and secure cycle parking provision for parking zones A, B, C, D, 1, 2, 3,4, 5c and 6 shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details shall identify and describe the location - physical as well as managerial (including means of access thereto; widths and gradients of ramps; location, type and operation of barriers to and within basement car parking; circulation space; lighting; CCTV; dedicated car parking provision for disabled people; and servicing arrangements arrangements for ventilation of basement car parking (including details of sound attenuation for any necessary mechanical plants and the standard of dilution expected); and internal treatment of basement car parking (including the location, type and appearance of all the directional signage in the car park for pedestrians to the lifts) Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and permanently retained in full working order thereafter. (i) No more than the approved number of car parking spaces shall be provided on or under the site for the development hereby permitted and such spaces shall be permanently available and not used for any other purpose than as approved. (ii)The cycle parking spaces shall be permanently available for the parking of cycles and not be used for any other purpose.. The details submitted should be set out in accordance with the approved Car Park Management Plan.
description: Variation of condition 15 (car parking arrangements) of planning permission 00505/P/P74 to change the allocation spread from 69 spaces to 99 spaces for the hotel and from 80 spaces to 50 spaces for the apart-hotel.
